name: B10-0464/2026 (ECR) – Human rights situation in Iran, notably the cases of Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human rights situation in Iran, notably the cases of Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for Iran to cancel the death sentences against two women, Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani, and to stop all executions. It wants all protesters and political prisoners freed, and an end to torture and forced confessions. It also asks the European Union to sanction Iranian judges who order politically motivated executions. This is the Parliament's opinion and request; it does not itself change any law or sentence.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament only asks Iran to act and the EU to add sanctions.
- **Who it affects:** Two women on death row, other detained protesters, and Iranian judges who could face EU sanctions.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to Iran's authorities. The EU Council is asked to list more officials.
